items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: He got you, he got Buck Clayton. I did some with him. He did some with you in Europe.

ctx.x: Tap dancers, yes. Europe had never seen these kind of dancers before. We did things throughout Germany, throughout Spain, throughout France. It was a most gratifying thing. It was very wonderful.
I remember that year before last, I think it was, Hugues Panassie's son, Hugues Panassio the great jazz impresario who lives in France and has contributed a great

deal to jazz - his son came over here and did a movie. It was like a discography of jazz. He got you, he got Buck Clayton. I did some with him. He did some with you in Europe. Then he came over here and did something with Jimmy Crawford.
